# Z-Frontier Layer-Shift States (1M run)

Source: the first 100 layer-shift records in
`docs/z_frontier_state_stats_1m.md`
(`--diagnostics --max-states 1000000`; 409,873 processed states).
No new searches were run; this document is derived from the two
diagnostics files.

## Notes on the columns

- **Duplicate elsewhere**: none of the 100 shift states appears in the
  duplicate-transition records. Every duplicate record is a
  placement-branch state, and each packed state is processed exactly
  once (its branch is fixed by whether the top layer equals `WORD_MASK`),
  so the two tables are disjoint; every shift record also reports 0
  already-seen successors. Whether a shift state was later re-generated
  as an already-seen successor is not observable from the capped
  diagnostics (only the first 100 duplicate sources are recorded, not
  their targets).
- **Processed index**: 1-based position in the processed-state stream.
  Records #1-4 lie in the BFS prefix shared with the 100k run, so their
  exact indices are taken from its per-state table; the 100k run found
  exactly 4 shifts in its 29,086 processed states, so records #5-100
  occur after index 29,086 and their exact indices are not recorded.
